subject: skill/world-model-loop/note-provenance
claim: Before trusting a world-model loop note, check its last commit: a note not changed in the current run is stale and about another task. Measured on the 2026-09-21 run — `notes/deviations.md` was last changed by `3689fb233` (the Item-4 execute) and `notes/posterior.md` by `077ad4837` (the Item-4 posterior), while the current run's prior/execute commits were `b00947b12`/`6985163dd`; so the posterior's ordered inputs were two documents about a different task until the posterior established provenance. `git log -1 -- notes/<file>` per inherited note is the cheap check; a note not minted/touched this run must be named as an unknown, not trusted.
